note: Engine cases for the §-INVOCATION exhibit (svc.l4, spec §2.3/§13.5).
KIE-FLAVOR ONLY: these cases drive svc.kie.dmn through the KIE harness.
The camunda golden (svc.dmn) is deliberately UNLOADABLE on Camunda 8 —
`special case` stays raw L4 on that flavor, and zeebe-dmn rejects raw-L4
literal expressions at parse() — which the MustFail leg in
jl4/tests-cli/Main.hs asserts with the parse failure named.
special_case pins the SERVICE invocation: its rendered body is
`special_assessment(p: 150, q: 5) + base_charge`, so its value (195) is
computed THROUGH the decisionService with the arguments bound per call —
while special_rate (the standalone decision, evaluated against the
global p and q these cases also bind) answers from the globals. The two
answering DIFFERENTLY in one case (B: 5 vs 195) is exactly the evidence
that the invocation carries its own bindings.

cases.name: B. globals below the floor; the invocation still binds 150/5
